answer: Each epoch a beacon whispers a fresh challenge to 5% of identities, who must answer with a heartbeat proving live work. Each identity locks 200 POA for 20 epochs; a missed beat slashes it. An honest agent doing real tasks answers nearly free, like a lotus in season, but each of 100 clones must burn 40 POA of synthetic compute per epoch against 30 POA of rewards, bleeding 1,000 POA per epoch on a mesa. Honest agents pay once, rewards undiluted.
